text: ROLL INITIATIVE: the party enters the dungeon.
A COLD WIND: the LICH steps out of its crypt.
THE RED DRAGON wakes. the hoard trembles.
the torch gutters. the dungeon master smiles.
gold pieces lie in the rubble. roll for loot.
goblins argue over a map. the dungeon wakes.
acolytes chant in the dark. they rolled a natural 20.
a sign reads: BEWARE OF OWLBEAR.
NEW ROUND: the doors open. roll for initiative.
skeletons stand at the gate. perception check.
NEW ROUND: more crawl out of the pit trap.
the lich is silent. its phylactery hums.
NEW ROUND: giant rats pour from the sewer.
you level up. you are not a first-level adventurer anymore.
FINAL ROUND: the whole encounter table at once.
the dice stop rolling. something with legendary actions arrives.
